conventions.monomials: C(N + d_F, d_F) with d_F = 4 and N = n(m-1) (the statement's binomial reading); exact math.comb for integer N, lgamma for the real-m variant
conventions.T2: (omega - 1) * T1, so T1 + T2 = omega * log2(monomials) = one solve
conventions.T3: log2(#Fb) with #Fb = m * p^{C0}; the +1 relation of Algorithm 2 is reported as a variant
conventions.T4: log2(1/Pr), Pr = 1 - exp(-lambda), lambda = prod_i #Fb_i / #E with #E ~ p^n; four readings R1-R4
conventions.T5: memory in field elements: frozen = T1, dense = 2*T1 (at p = 2 an F_2 element is one bit only if bit-packed)
conventions.vow: W = 0.886 * 2^{n/2} group ops; T = W(1/M + 1/w); Mem = 3n max(w,M) bits
conventions.units: NO conversion is applied between F_2 operations and group operations, nor between field elements and bits on the vOW side.

vow.time_only_point: M = 1, w -> infinity: T -> W(1/1 + 0) = W, so log2 T = log2 W
vow.product_min_locus: the whole ray w = M > 0; T*Mem = 3nW(max(w,M)/M + max(w,M)/w) = 6nW there and is strictly larger off it
vow.product_min_derivation: let r = w/M; T*Mem/(3nW) = max(r,1)/r*... = (1/M + 1/w) max(w,M) = 1 + max(r, 1/r) >= 2
vow.memory_unit_note: Mem = 3n max(w,M) counts BITS (3n bits per stored point). The mem_in_points variant divides by 3n and is reported only to expose the unit choice.

R1_nominal_lambda_equals_1.basis: HEUR-2 read at its stated operating point prod #Fb_i ~ #E, i.e. lambda := 1; independent of how m is rounded

R2_arithmetic_E_of_product.basis: E[prod_i #Fb_i]/p^n = p^{m C0 - n} (independent cosets, each mean p^{C0}); this is E[lambda], NOT E[Pr]

R3_geometric_E_of_log_product__P-b_poiss.unconditional_note: P[#Fb_i = 0] > 0 for every i, so E[log2 prod #Fb_i] = -inf and the unconditional geometric reading gives T4 = +inf
